decision: 토스 낚시 안내 실험을 시작하기 전에 현재 데이터와 계측의 연결성을 판정한다
source: BigQuery GA4 daily export, 2026-09-04 through 2026-09-12 KST

assumptions.assumption: event_params.platform=toss identifies observed Toss webview events, not first-ever game users.
assumptions.rationale: A device may have played elsewhere or before the observed window.
assumptions.validation: Reconcile platform and prior activity with deduplicated session logs.

assumptions.assumption: beta_A/beta_B flags exclude marked testers but may miss unmarked paid testers.
assumptions.rationale: The earlier Toss marker audit found zero marked rows.
assumptions.validation: Verify the paid tester roster against a durable experiment unit key before randomization.

assumptions.assumption: GA4 user_pseudo_id is an observed browser/device key but is not a proven crosswalk to the app client_id.
assumptions.rationale: None of the relevant historical Toss GA4 event rows contain a client_id parameter.
assumptions.validation: Log a privacy-safe stable experiment unit ID at assignment and verify its continuity with GA4 outcomes.

assumptions.assumption: tutorial_skip has multiple meanings: welcome skip, coach interruption, and reopened guide dismissal.
assumptions.rationale: The same client event name is emitted at several UI paths; at=welcome accounts for 16 historical rows.
assumptions.validation: Record a distinct first-eligible timestamp from runtime state rather than treating all tutorial_skip events as eligibility.

assumptions.assumption: fishing_cast records a successful cast attempt near the lake, not a catch or all fishing intent.
assumptions.rationale: The client emits it after distance validation; fishing_catch is a separate event.
assumptions.validation: Check duplicate emissions and event delivery in the 20-device-per-arm telemetry pilot.
